rows.requirement: Continuous output rating shall be at least 1200 kVA and 1200 kW at unity power factor, 480 V.
Full rating shall be available at an ambient operating temperature of 40 °C.
Input, bypass, and output electrical configuration shall be 480 V, 3-phase, 3-wire plus ground at 60 Hz.
UPS shall feature a double-conversion online design classified as VFI per IEC 62040-3.
Double-conversion AC-to-AC efficiency shall be at least 96% at 100% load.
Input power factor shall be at least 0.99 and full-load input current distortion (THDi) shall not exceed 5%.
Steady-state output voltage regulation shall be within +/-1% for balanced load changes from 0 to 100%.
Inverter must carry 125 percent of rated load for at least 10 minutes
Provide an automatic static bypass switch within the UPS
Provide a manual maintenance bypass furnished with the UPS
Provide VRLA or lithium-ion batteries sized for not less than 10 minutes runtime at full load
UPS must be capable of parallel operation with at least 3 additional units of the same rating
UPS must be listed to UL 1778
UPS shall be certified for seismic installation per the International Building Code
Each UPS shall fit within a maximum width of 110 inches, depth of 40 inches, and height of 84 inches.
Heat dissipation at full load shall not exceed 150,000 BTU per hour.

follow_ups.subject: Project Alpha UPS-A - submittal review comments (8 items)
follow_ups.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your submittal (vertiv-exl-s1-package) against the project specification. Please respond to each item below.

1. Double-conversion AC-to-AC efficiency shall be at least 96% at 100% load. (spec 2.1.E (Efficiency))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.1.E (Efficiency): "Double-conversion AC-to-AC efficiency shall be not less than 96 percent at 100 percent load"
   Your submittal: vertiv-exl-s1-package p.15: "≥96.8%"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

2. Provide an automatic static bypass switch within the UPS (spec 2.1.I (Static Bypass))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.1.I (Static Bypass): "Provide an automatic static bypass switch within the UPS"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

3. Provide VRLA or lithium-ion batteries sized for not less than 10 minutes runtime at full load (spec 2.1.K (Batteries))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.1.K (Batteries): "Valve-regulated lead-acid or lithium-ion, sized for not less than 10 minutes at full load"
   Your submittal: vertiv-exl-s1-package p.2: "standard VRLA and new Li-ion batteries"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

4. UPS must be capable of parallel operation with at least 3 additional units of the same rating (spec 2.1.L (Paralleling))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.1.L (Paralleling): "capable of operating in parallel with at least 3 additional units of the same rating"
   Your submittal: vertiv-exl-s1-package p.6: "up to 8 units in parallel"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

5. UPS must be listed to UL 1778 (spec 2.1.M (Listing))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.1.M (Listing): "The UPS shall be listed to UL 1778"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

6. UPS shall be certified for seismic installation per the International Building Code (spec 2.1.N (Seismic))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.1.N (Seismic): "certified for seismic installation in accordance with the International Building Code"
   Request: We could not find this in the submittal. Please provide the data sheet section or a written confirmation.

7. Each UPS shall fit within a maximum width of 110 inches, depth of 40 inches, and height of 84 inches. (spec 2.2.A (Dimensions))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.2.A (Dimensions): "Dimensions: Each UPS shall fit within 110 inches wide, 40 inches deep and 84 inches high."
   Your submittal: vertiv-exl-s1-package p.12: "Width (mm) 1000 1250 2000 2650"
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

8. Heat dissipation at full load shall not exceed 150,000 BTU per hour. (spec 2.2.B (Heat Dissipation))
   Specification: 26-33-53-static-ups-alpha p.1, 2.2.B (Heat Dissipation): "Heat Dissipation: Heat released at full load shall not exceed 150,000 BTU per hour."
   Request: The submittal is not clear on this point. Please confirm exactly what will be supplied for this project.

Thank you.
Procurement, Project Alpha
